title: Write 3 · 好 会 也 都 对 到 上 很 去 她 着 想 给 看 现
focus: 好 会 也 都 对 到 上 很 去 她 着 想 给 看 现
body:
Repeating parts: 女 (好, 她), 也 (也, 她), 目 eye (着, 看), 见 see (现), 厶 (会, 去), 寸 (对), 刂 (到).

## Rules that matter here
- **Top before bottom**: 会, 去, 想, 着, 看.
- **Left radicals shrink**: 女 in 好 and 王 in 现 end with a rising stroke instead of a flat one.
- 上 starts with the vertical; 下 starts with the horizontal.

cards.Notes: 女 woman (3) + 子 child (3) = 6 strokes. Left before right; 女's last stroke becomes a rising 提. Woman + child = good.
人 (2) on top + 云 cloud (4) = 6 strokes. Top before bottom; 云 = 二 then 厶. Lookalike: 去 (土 + 厶).
3 strokes: 横折钩, short vertical, then the long 竖弯钩 last. Appears in 他, 她, 地.

cards.Prompt: 我们＿去 · wǒmen dōu qù · we're all going
cards.Notes: 者 (8: 土, ノ, 日) + 阝 (2) = 10 strokes. Left first, 阝 on the right last. Also dū as in 首都.
又 hand (2) + 寸 inch (3) = 5 strokes. 又 shrinks on the left; 寸: 一, vertical hook, dot last.
至 arrive (6) + 刂 knife (2, here phonetic dāo) = 8 strokes. 至: 一, 𠃋, dot, then 土. Left before right.
3 strokes: vertical 丨 FIRST, then short horizontal to the right, long horizontal last. Mirror: 下 starts with the horizontal.
彳 step (3, double ノ + 丨) + 艮 (6, phonetic) = 9 strokes. Lookalikes: 银 (钅), 跟 (⻊), 根 (木).
土 (3) + 厶 (2) = 5 strokes. Top before bottom. Lookalike: 会 (人 + 云).
女 woman (3) + 也 (3) = 6 strokes. Left before right. Same sound as 他 and 它; the 女 marks 'she'.
Top 𦍌 (丷, 三, long ノ = 6) + 目 eye (5) = 11 strokes. Lookalike: 看 (手-like top, no 丷). Also zháo, zhāo.
相 (9: 木 + 目, phonetic xiāng) + 心 heart (4) = 13 strokes. Top before bottom; 心: dot, 乚 hook, dot, dot.

cards.Prompt: 送＿ · sònggěi · to give as a gift
cards.Notes: 纟 silk (3) + 合 join (6) = 9 strokes. 纟: two 𠃋 folds then the rising 提. Left before right.
手-like top (4: ノ, 一, 一, long ノ) + 目 eye (5) = 9 strokes. A hand over the eye = to look. Lookalike: 着.
王 jade (4) + 见 see (4, phonetic jiàn) = 8 strokes. On the left, 王's last horizontal becomes a rising 提.
